# react-magic-ui

> Liquid glass React components in the style of Apple iOS 26. Plain CSS, React 18/19, TypeScript types and JSDoc on every prop. This file is the short guide for AI agents and people new to the kit. Also shipped in the package: `node_modules/react-magic-ui/llms.txt`.

## Setup

```bash
npm install react-magic-ui
```

```tsx
// once, at the app entry (main.tsx, app/layout.tsx, _app.tsx)
import "react-magic-ui/style.css";
```

- Components are client components (the bundle starts with `"use client"`), so they work in the Next.js app router and render on the server without touching `window`.
- Font: system SF Pro on Apple devices, Inter (bundled, loaded by the JS import) elsewhere.
- Glass needs something behind it. Put the UI over an image, video, gradient or colourful page. Over a flat colour, glass just looks grey.

## Rules (follow these, they are how iOS 26 does it)

1. **Don't put glass on glass yourself.** Nesting is handled: any kit component inside another glass surface (Card, Topbar, Sidebar, Modal…) renders as an inner layer of it automatically. Never wrap a `Card` in a `Glass` just for looks.
2. **One prominent action per screen or bar**, on the trailing side. Everything else is `variant="glass"` (the default).
3. **Red is a role, not a style.** Use `destructive` for delete/remove. There are no success/warning/info buttons or badges.
4. **Status colours belong to toasts**, not buttons: `showToast({ variant: "success" | "error" | "info" })`.
5. **Badges**: a glass label (`<Badge>Beta</Badge>`) or the red notification count (`variant="notification"`).
6. **Switches are green when on**, as on iOS. Change with `tint` only for a reason (brand colour).
7. **Content panels** that hold lots of text can use `material="frosted"` (softer blur, no lens). Controls and bars stay `"glass"`.
8. **Every value control is controlled or uncontrolled** with the same names:
   - booleans: `checked` / `defaultChecked` / `onCheckedChange` (Switch, Checkbox)
   - values: `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange` (Select, Slider, Tabs)
   - open state: `open` / `onOpenChange` (Modal, Select's `onOpenChange`)
9. **Accessibility**: icon-only buttons need `aria-label`; Switch, Slider and Select need `aria-label` or a visible `<label>`.

## Theme and ink

- Dark theme: add class `dark` (or `data-theme="dark"`) on `<html>` or any ancestor.
- Ink (text colour on glass): `tone="auto" | "light" | "dark"` on a component, or `data-glass-tone="light" | "dark"` on any ancestor for a whole area. Use `tone="light"` (light text) over dark photos in the light theme.
- Colours are CSS variables you can override on `:root`:
  `--rmu-accent` (prominent buttons, slider fill; default `--rmu-blue`), `--rmu-blue`, `--rmu-green`, `--rmu-red`, `--rmu-orange`, `--rmu-gray`, `--rmu-font`.
- Every component takes `className` and `style` on its root, and forwards `ref`.

## Motion

Built in, nothing to wire up: pressed glass swells and lights up from the touch point, Switch and Slider thumbs turn into clear glass bubbles while held or dragged, and the Select menu grows out of its trigger and folds back into it. All of it switches off under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

## Components

### Button
```tsx
<Button onClick={cancel}>Cancel</Button>
<Button variant="prominent" onClick={save}>Done</Button>
<Button destructive onClick={remove}>Delete</Button>
<Button variant="prominent" destructive>Delete account</Button>
<Button variant="prominent" tint="var(--rmu-green)">Answer</Button>
<Button rounded aria-label="Search"><SearchIcon /></Button>
```
Props: `variant` `"glass" | "prominent"` (default glass), `destructive`, `tint` (any CSS colour), `size` `"small" | "medium" | "large"` (32/44/52px), `rounded` (circle icon button), `text` or `children`, plus all `<button>` props.

### Badge
```tsx
<Badge>Beta</Badge>
<Badge tint="var(--rmu-blue)">New</Badge>
<Badge variant="notification" aria-label="3 unread">3</Badge>
```
Props: `variant` `"default" | "notification"`, `tint`, `leadingIcon`, `trailingIcon`.

### Card
```tsx
<Card>
  <h3>Settings</h3>
  <Switch aria-label="Wi-Fi" />
</Card>
```
Props: `size` `"small" | "medium" | "large"`, `direction` `"column" | "row"`, `align`, `justify`, `gap` (px), `material` `"glass" | "frosted"`.

### Input
```tsx
<Input placeholder="Search" leadingIcon={<SearchIcon />} value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} />
```
Props: all `<input>` props (`ref` and `className` go to the `<input>`), `size`, `leadingIcon`, `trailingIcon`, `invalid`, `wrapperClassName`, `wrapperStyle`.

### Switch
```tsx
<Switch aria-label="Wi-Fi" checked={wifi} onCheckedChange={setWifi} />
```
Props: `checked`, `defaultChecked`, `onCheckedChange`, `tint`, `size`, `disabled`.

### Checkbox
```tsx
<Checkbox label="Remember me" checked={remember} onCheckedChange={setRemember} />
```
Props: `checked`, `defaultChecked`, `onCheckedChange`, `label`, `size`, `disabled`.

### Slider
```tsx
<Slider aria-label="Volume" value={volume} onValueChange={setVolume} showValue />
```
Props: `value`, `defaultValue` (50), `onValueChange`, `min` (0), `max` (100), `step` (1), `size`, `showValue`, `disabled`. Keyboard: arrows, Page Up/Down, Home/End.

### Select
```tsx
<Select
  aria-label="Size"
  options={[{ value: "s", label: "Small" }, { value: "l", label: "Large" }]}
  value={size}
  onValueChange={setSize}
  name="size" // optional: posts with a <form>
/>
```
Props: `options` (`{ value, label, disabled? }[]`), `value`, `defaultValue`, `onValueChange`, `onOpenChange`, `placeholder`, `name`, `size`, `disabled`, `id`. `ref` points at the trigger button.

### Tabs
```tsx
<Tabs defaultValue="day">
  <Tabs.List aria-label="Range">
    <Tabs.Trigger value="day">Day</Tabs.Trigger>
    <Tabs.Trigger value="week">Week</Tabs.Trigger>
  </Tabs.List>
  <Tabs.Content value="day">…</Tabs.Content>
  <Tabs.Content value="week">…</Tabs.Content>
</Tabs>
```
Props: `value`, `defaultValue`, `onValueChange`, `activationMode` `"auto" | "manual"`, `orientation`. `Tabs.Content` takes `lazyMount`.

### Modal
```tsx
<Modal
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  title="Delete photo?"
  description="This can't be undone."
  footer={<>
    <Button onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button variant="prominent" destructive onClick={remove}>Delete</Button>
  </>}
/>
```
Props: `open`, `onOpenChange` / `onClose`, `title`, `description`, `footer`, `children`, `size` `"sm" | "md" | "lg"`, `closeOnOverlay`, `closeOnEsc`, `lockScroll` (keeps the scrollbar, blocks page scroll), `portalContainer`. Portals to `document.body` and keeps the theme and tone of where it's declared.

### Toast
```tsx
// once near the root
<ToastProvider position="top-right" duration={4000}>
  <App />
</ToastProvider>

// anywhere below
const { showToast, dismissToast, clearToasts } = useToast();
showToast({ variant: "success", title: "Saved", description: "Synced to iCloud." });
```
Toast fields: `title`, `description`, `variant` `"default" | "success" | "error" | "info"`, `duration` (ms, `Infinity` to keep), `position`, `animation` `"slide-from-right" | "slide-from-left" | "slide-from-bottom" | "scale"`, `id`, `onClose`. `showToast` returns the id.

### Topbar
```tsx
<Topbar size="compact">
  <Topbar.Brand icon={<Logo />} title="My app" subtitle="Dashboard" />
  <Topbar.Section grow><Input placeholder="Search" /></Topbar.Section>
  <Topbar.Actions>
    <Button size="small">Share</Button>
    <Button size="small" variant="prominent">New</Button>
  </Topbar.Actions>
</Topbar>
```
Parts: `Topbar.Brand`, `Topbar.Section` (`grow`, `align`, `gap`, `wrap`), `Topbar.Actions` (`gap`), `Topbar.Divider`. Props: `size` `"compact" | "comfortable" | "spacious"`, `elevated`.

### Sidebar
```tsx
<Sidebar collapsible activeItemId={page} onSelectItem={setPage}>
  <Sidebar.Header>My app<Sidebar.Toggle /></Sidebar.Header>
  <Sidebar.Items>
    <Sidebar.Item itemId="home" icon={<HomeIcon />}>Home</Sidebar.Item>
    <Sidebar.Item itemId="inbox" icon={<InboxIcon />} badge={<Badge variant="notification">3</Badge>}>Inbox</Sidebar.Item>
  </Sidebar.Items>
  <Sidebar.Footer>v2.0</Sidebar.Footer>
</Sidebar>
```
Props: `activeItemId`, `defaultActiveItemId`, `onSelectItem(itemId, event)`, `collapsible`, `collapsed`, `defaultCollapsed`, `onToggle`, `size`. Collapsed, it shows icons only.

### Glass (build your own surface)
```tsx
<Glass className="player" style={{ padding: 16, borderRadius: 24 }}>Now playing</Glass>
<Glass as="button" interactive onClick={play}>Play</Glass>
```
Props: `as` (any element or component), `interactive` (hover + press spring), `selected`, `material`, `tone`, `lens` (rim refraction, Chromium only; other browsers get flat glass), `layer` `"auto" | "surface" | "inner"`. Use `layer="surface"` for floating things that must stay real glass (popovers). `useGlassDepth()` tells a custom component whether it sits on glass.

## Types

Every prop type is exported: `ButtonProps`, `ButtonVariant`, `BadgeProps`, `SelectOption`, `ToastDefinition`, `ToastVariant`, `GlassTone`, `ModalSize` and so on.
